headline: Expert review of Paraquat and Carbosulfan sent to the Government (Paraquat was later banned); Certified Reference Materials need no import permit; Crystal's Halosulfuron registrations quashed by the Delhi High Court; insecticidal paints handled as household products for now.

changes.t: Paraquat and Carbosulfan: expert review to Government
changes.d: The RC considered the Dr Debasisa Mohanty committee's report (section 27(2) consultation) and sent its recommendations to the Government of India; the RC will implement its final decision. (Paraquat was banned by S.O. 5234(E) on 22.09.2026.)

changes.t: Certified Reference Materials: no import permit
changes.d: CRMs, including banned or restricted pesticides, used only in small quantities for lab testing, calibration, method validation and R&D are exempt from CIB&RC import permission. (Public notice 10.09.2026.)

changes.t: Halosulfuron registrations of Crystal Crop quashed
changes.d: The Delhi High Court (LPA 215/2023, Dhanuka v Union of India) set aside the 430th/431st RC approvals; Crystal was asked to surrender the CRs and the States were informed. (Supreme Court later stayed the judgment; see 474th.)

changes.t: Insecticidal paints under the household category
changes.d: Biocide guidelines are stayed by the Delhi High Court, so Indigo Paints' Permethrin paint may be considered as a household product if it gives ecotoxicity and other data like earlier applicants.

changes.t: Maleic Hydrazide technical for export formulations
changes.d: UPL may import Maleic Hydrazide technical only to make export formulations; DA&FW asked to notify this in the Gazette.
Import of Thiourea (PI Industries) and one past consignment of DMDS (BPCL) approved.

changes.t: Revision orders on Agrow Allied (Godrej Agrovet)
changes.d: Remanded case re-examined for manufacturing process, impurity profile and toxicology.

actions: Labs importing reference standards: no CIB&RC import permit needed.
Insecticidal paint applicants: prepare ecotoxicity and exposure data.
